preconditions.description: Each number in the input is an odd number greater than 61.

postconditions.description: If a valid triplet of primes exists, the output will not be '0 0 0'.

postconditions.expression: output == '0 0 0' or (is_prime(P1) and is_prime(P2) and is_prime(P3) and P1 + P2**2 + P3**3 == number)
postconditions.description: The output will be a valid triplet of primes P1, P2, P3 such that P1 + P2^2 + P3^3 equals the input number.
